code.description: Canonical authorization codes: GUIDANCE_BACKFILL, NEW_RELEASE_NOTE_SURFACE, RELEASED_HISTORY_REWRITE. Coin a new uppercase code only for an authority they do not cover.

identifierRole.description: Semantic role of the identifier. Exactly one record per releaseTrain may use canonical-release.

field.description: Named field inside path. Omit for headings and destinations without one.

releaseTrain.description: Release train this identifier belongs to. Required whenever more than one train is involved.

code.description: Canonical verification codes: BACKFILL_AUDIT, RELEASE_NOTES_SYNC, SURFACE_SCOPE_FILTERING, VERSION_CONSISTENCY. Coin a new uppercase code only for a check they do not cover.
